title: CLM-Bench: Benchmarking and Analyzing Cross-lingual Misalignment of LLMs in Knowledge Editing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-lingual misalignment by testing whether knowledge edits applied in one language (e.g., English) successfully transfer to another (e.g., Chinese), and computing language-bias correlation, projection differences, and vector orthogonality in the model's layer-wise hidden representations.

Constructing a native Chinese-first knowledge editing benchmark (CLM-Bench) containing culturally specific entities (e.g., Chinese history, literature, and local celebrities) to evaluate and counteract the English-centric entity bias prevalent in traditional translation-based datasets.
